protocol.freeze_status: Written before this target is evaluated in this task; original 2000–2024 one-month benchmark has already been inspected. RETROSPECTIVE benchmark, not a fresh or prospective holdout.
protocol.target: Y_t=1 iff min(P_{t+1},...,P_{t+12}) <= 0.8*P_t. All twelve consecutive future monthly observations must be present to score a row, including positive outcomes. Every feature-ready forecast month is eligible, including already-drawn-down months. Price is reset to current P_t for every forecast; this is additional loss, not crossing a prior peak threshold.
protocol.features: Log(P_t/P_t-1), log(P_t/P_t-12), sample std ddof=1 of 12 consecutive log returns, P_t/max(P_t-11...P_t)-1. No future inputs. Missing months are not filled.
protocol.distance_definition: Distance is past drawdown from trailing peak, not distance to the target barrier: prospective loss barrier is always20% below current price, making current barrier distance constant. The simple model uses only past drawdown and volatility.
protocol.partition_rule: Both first future month and twelfth future month must fall within the partition; latest forecast dates train1983-12, development1996-12,test2023-12. Earliest development forecast1986-12, test1999-12. Embargo outcome years1985–1986 and1998–1999; no labels cross boundaries.
protocol.fit: Train-only mean/population-std scaling; pooled unweighted logistic mean log loss with unpenalized intercept and lambda/2 squared standardized slopes. No class weights. Constant=train event prevalence. No refit on development or test.
protocol.selection: Each logistic candidate selects lambda by development Brier; choose final candidate, including constant, by smallest development Brier. Ties favor constant then simpler model then full; lambda ties favor first grid entry. No later model choice based on test, Nasdaq or case performance.
protocol.uncertainty: 2000 circular moving-block bootstrap resamples of24consecutive forecast calendar months. Within-month all industries retained jointly; extend blocks with wraparound, truncate to original month count. Paired Brier differences vsconstant and full-vs-simple. Approximate intervals address overlapping labels and shared shocks but not longer dependence, model-selection uncertainty, or prospective generalization.
protocol.nasdaq: Fixed selected industry candidate applied without retuning to Nasdaq month-end closes, retrospective outcome windows2000–2024. Current asofAugust2026 forecasts Sep2026–Aug2027 and has no observed outcome. It is a broad-tech price-index transfer, not an AI probability.
protocol.cases: Main10 replacesUS1987 withUSrailroadsApr1872pricepeak/name1873panic; other original9unchanged. Display asof24months before through24months after peak. Nasdaq andNikkei use true month-end daily closes; BTC daily reference-rate last observation each month; others retain monthly published/mean indices and explicit target-frequency mismatch. Coefficients/future-period leakage and feature range are labeled; selected cases are not performance denominator.
protocol.out_of_domain: Always flag cross-asset/country/price-vs-total-return population transfer. For each row also report features outside train min/max (univariate support only; withinrange does not establish joint-domain validity). No clipping/recalibration.
